It is highly improbable that prosecutrix stretched herself without raising any alarm and no injuries were sustained by her.
Applicant is a boy aged about 22 years and confinement amounts to pretrial detention specially when the applicant does not bear any criminal record.
He undertakes to cooperate in trial and not to be a source of harassment or embarrassment to the complainant party in any manner and that he will not move in her vicinity.
On these grounds prayer for bail is made out.
Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer and prayed for rejection of appeal.
Heard.

Considering the submissions and fact situation and looking to the period of custody and the applicant is a boy aged 22 years and he does not bear any criminal record, without commenting on the merits of case, appeal is allowed and it is directed that appellant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 50,000/-(Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of like amount to the satisfaction of Trial Court.
The appellant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be.

7. The appellant shall appear first Sunday of every month before the Police Station,
Mauganj, District Rewa between 10.30 am to 1.30 pm to mark his presence till conclusion of trial.
